This is a senior-level software engineering role on Datadog's CI/CD Security team, within its SDLC Security organization. The work involves building a new security layer for Datadog's continuous integration and delivery infrastructure, covering trusted build provenance, secure secret delivery, and real-time policy enforcement at the network layer in the critical path of software delivery. The core stack centers on a modern backend language such as Go, Python, Rust, Java, or JavaScript, along with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure and Kubernetes-based infrastructure.
